messages:
maya.chen: hey security team — we've got a SOC2 customer questionnaire asking for (1) a dataflow diagram for our hosted inference, (2) list of subprocessors, and (3) confirmation around logs/PII redaction. quick Q: can i share our internal PPT, or do we use a customer-safe export? also who signs off on the logs statement? need to reply by EOD.

alex.k: short answer: don't share internal PPT. we have a customer-facing dataflow PDF in Confluence. use that export. subprocessors list is maintained by privacy. pinging @timothy and @jordan for compliance + privacy sign-off.

maya.chen: thanks — can you drop the confluence link?

alex.k: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/sec/pages/DF-2023-Hosted-Inference-Dataflow — click 'Customer-safe export'. subprocessors: https://redwood.internal/vendor-inventory (export -> privacy review). For logs: we run log-redact pipeline (https://tools.redwood/logs/redact) that strips user_text and secrets. For SOC2 statements we need Compliance approval before sending.

timothy: I'll review and can sign the customer response. if they want screenshots/evidence we can provide the exported PDF + sanitized subprocessors list. Please remove any internal buckets from the export.

jordan: Confirming logging behavior: production request/response logs are redacted. debug/dev-mode logs may contain raw content and are disabled for customer environments. Suggested wording to give the customer:

"Production request and response logs are redacted to remove user-provided content and secrets. Access to raw logs is limited to authorized personnel via approved access requests and is logged for auditing."

maya.chen: perfect — i'll paste that. who approves access tickets for raw logs if the customer asks for evidence?

dave: eng-sre leads approve (sam, linda). they also require a ticket with justification and TTL.

alex.k: i'll pre-approve the export for this customer once maya attaches the ticket. security-bot: created ticket INF-4521 for customer dataflow export (https://jira.redwood/INF-4521).

security-bot: Ticket INF-4521 updated: assignee alex.k, status: In Review.

maya.chen: thanks all — closing loop. i'll send the confluence export + suggested wording to the customer and cc @timothy and @jordan. will update the ticket with what we sent.

sam: thanks, maya. ping if buyer asks for encryption-at-rest keys details; we'll route that through compliance.
